scope: Fresh debug Tauri macOS app bundle with the rebuilt PyInstaller sidecar and an isolated data directory.

webview_result.before: The packaged app kept showing the 20-second desktop Host unavailable message although its sidecar health endpoint responded.
webview_result.change: FastAPI CORS now permits the three Tauri origins used by the packaged WebView: https://tauri.localhost, http://tauri.localhost and tauri://localhost.
webview_result.after: The rebuilt package renders the World Center with the visible status '桌面 Host 已就绪'.

verification: vnext/backend: .venv/bin/python -m ruff check src tests => passed
vnext/desktop: npm run tauri:build -- --debug --bundles app => passed
limits: This proves that the rebuilt packaged macOS WebView can call its bundled Host; a sidecar health response alone was not treated as proof.
The captured probe response proves the complete Ollama profile and protocol response, but the visual capture does not independently show a completed probe success state.
The packaged Mac AI draft review, invalid-JSON restore, atomic compose, three choices, ending, rollback and restart-reentry journey is still unverified.
No Android interaction was performed in this phase. This evidence must not raise Android or overall maturity.
